messages:
tess: Heads-up: legal flagged a path where EU-resident writes fall back to us-east during eu-west OOM. Need a quick shipping mode: deny | escrow | tag+audit. Short discussion and owners please.

omar: My take: escrow gives best availability without immediate cross-border writes. But it's extra infra.

sree: Ops note: escrow needs queue quotas, TTL, and ticketing. If we deny, clients will get 409 and raise support tickets.

ops-bot: alert: eu-west fallback_ratio=0.015 over 5m.

tess: Proposal: add tenant.policy = STRICT|ESCROW|AUDIT, support X-Residence-Override header when tenant allows. Proxy returns 202 with ticket when escrowed, 409 for strict, and 200+audit-tag for audit.

omar: I'll own proxy header + error codes PR.

sree: I'll prototype minimal escrow queue (region-scoped) and add metric escrow.queue_len.

tess: Thanks. I'll draft a short RFC addendum and runbook stub.
